tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: Looks up one domain in WHOIS/RDAP and returns whether it is registered, its expiry and registration dates, days until expiry, registrar, status codes and nameservers. Results may be cached for up to 48 hours. Does not need a TLDix account.

tools.name: check_domain_expiries
tools.description: Checks up to 25 domains at once and returns each one's expiry date, days left and registrar, sorted by what expires first. Domains that time out are marked "pending" and can be checked again. Does not need a TLDix account.

tools.name: check_ssl_certificate
tools.description: Connects to the domain on port 443 and returns the TLS certificate's issuer, validity dates, days until expiry and the names it covers. Does not need a TLDix account.

tools.name: get_account_overview
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user's TLDix plan, how many domains, hosting and licence items they track against their plan limits, and the next five renewals.

tools.name: list_upcoming_renewals
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user's domains, hosting and licence/service renewals that expire within the given number of days (already expired items are included), sorted by date.

tools.name: list_tracked_domains
tools.description: Lists the domains the signed-in user tracks in TLDix with expiry date, days left, registrar and which alert days are on. Supports a name filter and paging.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Adds a domain to the signed-in user's TLDix tracking list so they get expiry alerts. Looks the domain up first; fails with a clear message if it is not registered or the plan's domain limit is reached. Adding a domain that is already tracked changes nothing.

tools.name: add_hosting_renewal
tools.description: Adds a hosting plan renewal (provider, the site it hosts and its renewal date) to the signed-in user's TLDix list. Alerts go out 30, 7 and 1 days before the date.

tools.name: add_license_renewal
tools.description: Adds a software licence, plugin, theme, SaaS subscription or other service renewal to the signed-in user's TLDix list. Alerts go out 30, 7 and 1 days before the date.

tools.name: remove_tracked_item
tools.description: Removes one item from the signed-in user's TLDix list: a domain by name, or a hosting or licence item by the id shown in list_upcoming_renewals. Its alerts stop.
